endpoint.sample_pmh_record: {"format": ["application/pdf"], "description": ["The purpose of this study was to examine the effects of teaching specific mindfulness techniques to teens who have difficulty functioning in the classroom, using the Mindful Schools Curricula; the course includes 18 lessons on being mindful of sound, breath, movement, thoughts, and emotions. Specifically, the study was designed to determine whether a mindfulness course would be beneficial for South Parish High School teens who are expelled. The study design was mixed methods. Participants were administered pre- and post- scientific validated survey scales that measure mindfulness characteristics as one data source. Participants\u2019 parents were given a questionnaire to return and interviews were attempted for all. Participants were guided in mindfulness sessions held twice a week for one hour per week for ten weeks during the 2017 fall semester. Benefits for participants in the study include increased awareness of their behaviors in present time in the hopes for them to respond rather than reacting."], "identifier": ["https://digitalcommons.lsu.edu/gradschool_theses/4849", "https://digitalcommons.lsu.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=5869&context=gradschool_theses"], "type": ["text"], "creator": ["Lee, Michelle L"], "publisher": ["LSU Digital Commons"], "subject": ["Behavior Mindfulness Discipline Teens", "Education", "Social and Philosophical Foundations of Education"], "date": ["2018-11-20T08:00:00Z"], "title": ["Mindfulness and Teen Behavior: Teenagers' Perceptions of Behavior that led to Expulsion"], "source": ["LSU Master's Theses"]}

endpoint.sample_pmh_record: {"format": ["application/pdf"], "publisher": ["Edith Cowan University, Research Online, Perth, Western Australia"], "type": ["thesis"], "identifier": ["https://ro.ecu.edu.au/theses/507", "https://ro.ecu.edu.au/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1508&context=theses"], "date": ["2011-01-01T08:00:00Z"], "title": ["They reckon I need a dramaturg : examining the value of a dramaturg to both the playwright and the professional theatre company in Australia"], "subject": ["dramaturgy", "dramaturg", "playwright", "australia", "drama", "theatre", "playwriting", "technique", "Playwriting", "Theatre and Performance Studies"], "description": ["This thesis examines aspects of dramaturgy delivered by a dramaturg, and the practical contributions of dramaturgs to both the writer and the theatre industry in Australia. It investigates elements of the working relationship between dramaturgs and playwrights, looks at the chameleon-like nature of the theatre dramaturg and examines how Australian writers, directors and dramaturgs perceive the role/s of the dramaturg. The thesis is partly a reflective investigation of personal practice, partly an historical investigation of the emergence of Australian ideas about dramaturgy, and partly an active investigation into what can help to make a constructive playwright/dramaturg relationship. A major aim of this investigation is to examine the practical aspects of the dramaturg\u00e2\u0080\u0099s work, and the effect of dramaturgy on playwrights and their scripts. What outcomes of a writer/dramaturg relationship can be observed? Can the effect of discussion and oral examination of a script be measured accurately? Outlining the areas considered by a dramaturg when discussing a script gives an indication of how a playwright is urged to think more deeply about the world of his or her play. Additionally, placing myself in the position of receiving dramaturgical input has expanded my understanding of the doors dramaturgy opens and the dead-end alleys it can warn against. Through my research I have discovered that there are important questions to consider regarding the parameters of the playwright/dramaturg relationship. These considerations need to be addressed at the beginning of any collaboration between a dramaturg and playwright. However the two individuals are also subject to the ambiguous nature of dramaturgy in the Australian setting, which brings external pressures to bear on the relationship by companies and other stakeholders."], "source": ["Theses: Doctorates and Masters"], "creator": ["Low, Polly"]}

{"creator": ["González Hernández, Marta"], "language": ["es"], "description": ["El objetivo de esta tesis consiste en el diseño y la evaluación de un nuevo prototipo de instrumento (perímetro Pulsar), que tiene la capacidad de estudiar numerosas funciones visuales (resolución espacial, contraste, color, movimiento y modulación temporal). Asimismo se estudió su posible aplicación al diagnóstico precoz del glaucoma. Material y métodos: En primer lugar se diseñó el aparato que consiste en un ordenador dotado de dos monitores. El primer monitor es de alta resolución, está controlado fotométricamente y se usa como pantalla de generación de estímulos,mientras que el segundo cumple la función de unidad de control.
La tesis se estructuró en 4 fases. En la primera se estudiaron 20 ojos de 20 sujetos normales con 12 tipos de perimetría de contraste para diferentes niveles de resolución espacial (ICP-0W a ICP-11W). El objetivo era establecer las curvas
de sensibilidad al contraste en función de la resolución espacial en cada punto del campo visual. En la segunda fase, se comparó la fluctuación de los umbrales contraste encontrados para una resolución espacial determinada, de 2.5 ciclos/grado (ICP-7W), con la obtenida utilizando una escala combinada de resolución espacial y contraste. Se estudiaron 4 pacientes 12 veces con cada tipo de perimetría. En la tercera fase, se establecieron los valores de normalidad
de la perimetría de escala combinada en 56 sujetos. Cada sujeto fue examinado dos veces con estímulos estáticos, con estímulos en movimiento a 8 ciclos/grado (CP-K6W) y con estímulos modulados en fase y contrafase a 30 Hz (CP-T30W).
En la cuarta y última fase, se estudiaron 82 pacientes diagnosticados de hipertensión ocular o glaucoma temprano. Fueron clasificados en 6 niveles diagnósticos según el grado de certeza de sufrir daño glaucomatoso. Se emplearon las perimetrías combinadas CP-K6W y CP-T30W en el perímetro Pulsar y la perimetría de umbral luminoso diferencial en el perímetro Octopus 1- 2-3. En todos los casos se utilizó la estrategia perimétrica TOP (Tendency Oriented Perimetry).", "Purpose: Design and evaluation of a new instrument prototype (Pulsar
perimeter) that has the ability of examining several visual functions (spatial
resolution, contrast, colour, motion and temporal modulation) and the study of its possible application for the early diagnosis of glaucoma.
Material and Methods: After the design of the apparatus; that consisted on a computer with two screens, one with high resolution and photometrical control, used to generate the stimuli and another one used as control unit; the thesis was divided in 4 phases: During the first one, 20 eyes from 20 subjects were examined with 12 types of contrast perimetry for different spatial resolution levels
(ICP-0W to ICP-11W), to establish the contrast sensitivity curves in relation to spatial resolution for each point in the visual field. During the second one, contrast threshold fluctuation for spatial resolution of 2.5 cycl/deg (ICP-7W) was compared to that found for a combined spatial resolution and contrast scale. Four patients were examined 12 times with each type of perimetry. For the third phase,
the normality values for the combined scale perimetry were established in 56 subjects. Each subject was examined twice with three types of perimetry: static stimuli (CP-SW), moving stimuli at 8 cycl/deg (CP-K6W) and stimuli modulated in phase and counter-phase at 30 Hz (CP-T30W). On the fourth and last phase, 82 patients diagnosed of early glaucoma or ocular hypertension, classified in 6 diagnostic levels depending on the level of reliability of suffering glaucomatous damage, were examined. Combined perimetries CP-K6W and CP-T30W and differential luminous threshold perimetry using the Octopus 1-2-3 perimeter were used.
In all cases TOP (Tendency Oriented Perimetry) perimetric strategy was
applied.
Results: The contrast sensitivity functions in the different regions of the visual field drop in a parallel fashion, moving towards higher spatial resolution levels
with eccentricity. From this observation came out the possibility of establishing a combined spatial resolution and contrast scale that was used in the remaining phases. During the second phase, the lower fluctuation of the combined scale (CP-SW) in relation to ICP-7W perimetry was proven. In the third one, the normal d patterns for combined stimulus perimetries CP-SW, CP-K6W and CP-T30W were established. The threshold differences between the central and peripheral visual
field was higher than in conventional perimetry, mostly on the nasal field. The results for each type of perimetry were respectively: Mean Sensitivity (MS) for 20 years 25.8, 25.3 and 24.7 src (spatial resolution and contrast units); loss per year 0.108, 0.083 and 0.089 src; threshold correlation coefficient with age (and error of estimation of Y over X) was ¿0.68 (1.81 src), -0.68 (1.61 src) and ¿0.72 (1.66 src); fluctuation 2.38, 1.81 and 2.21 src; percentage of points deviated more than 5 src from the normal value 7.5%, 5.9% and 6.7%. In the clinical phase, specificity was fixed at 96.4% (CP-T30W) and at 94.6% (CP-K6W) for a cut off level of Mean Deviation (MD)=3 src. Sensitivity for level 0 (ocular hypertension) was 34.5% (CP-T30W) and 24.1% (CP-K6W). The ROC area curves for CPT30W
increased from 0.88 (level 1) to 0.99 (level 5) and sensitivity from 69.8% to
100%. The ROC areas for CP-K6W increased from 0.83 to 0.97 for the same groups, but sensitivity was 75% for level 5. MD correlation between both Pulsar perimetries was r=0.88, but it was lower with luminous threshold perimetry (r=0.58 for CP-T30W and r=0.59 for CP-K6W).
Conclusions: Contrast perception in relation to spatial resolution can be
estimated in the visual field with a precision similar to conventional luminous threshold perimetry, providing normal values with little dispersion. Case study of Mexico."], "type": ["Tesis"], "identifier": ["http://ccdoc.iteso.mx/acervo/cat.aspx?cmn=browse&id=1986"], "contributor": ["(Universidad de Guadalajara, DECS)"], "publisher": ["Stanford University"], "description": ["USA", "Este trabajo analiza, desde una perspectiva hist\u00f3rico-estructural, el desarrollo de la televisi\u00f3n en M\u00e9xico, su car\u00e1cter comercial y las relaciones del medio con el Estado y el proceso de acumulaci\u00f3n de capital. Se remonta a los or\u00edgenes de la televisi\u00f3n en M\u00e9xico y examina varios episodios controvertidos de naturaleza pol\u00edtica relacionados con el medio. Subraya que la mediaci\u00f3n del Estado ha reforzado el car\u00e1cter comercial de la televisi\u00f3n y ha fortalecido el poder de los grupos que controlan este medio de educaci\u00f3n informal. Concluye que el car\u00e1cter comercial, el crecimiento y la concentraci\u00f3n de la televisi\u00f3n se explican por las necesidades de acumulaci\u00f3n de capital -nacional y transnacional- con la participaci\u00f3n del Estado mexicano. Asimismo, encuentra una contradicci\u00f3n importante entre el creciente alcance social, la influencia y el significado de la televisi\u00f3n, y su control, apropiaci\u00f3n y explotaci\u00f3n por unos cuantos."]}
